answer_1.quote: Text simplification involves the rewriting of a text to make it easier to read and understand by a wider audience, while still expressing the same core meaning.

answer_2.quote: We compare SLE with four reference-based and two reference-less metrics previously used to assess the output of simplification models.

answer_4.quote: We test the effectiveness of the metric by comparing its correlation with two datasets of human simplicity ratings: Simplicity-DA and Human-Likert.
answer_4.guideline: to measure simplicity gain vs. the input
